name: Aesthetic & Smile Design Dentistry — Veneers, Whitening, Prosthetics, Pediatric Esthetics
description: Comprehensive approach to smile enhancement, color and shape correction, veneers, whitening, bonding, and fixed prosthodontic artistry. Integrates digital smile design, facial harmony analysis, pediatric esthetics, and minimally invasive techniques aligned with global standards.
keywords: aesthetic dentistry, smile design, veneers, laminates, tooth whitening, composite bonding, crowns, bridges, smile correction, pediatric esthetics, digital smile design, tooth reshaping, diastema closure, prosthetic rehabilitation

hasPart.name: Dental Veneers (Porcelain / Composite Laminates)
hasPart.description: Thin custom shells bonded to front teeth to improve color, shape, and alignment. Designed digitally and crafted from porcelain or composite.
hasPart.followup: Polishing and review at 1–2 weeks; bite assessment.

guideline.guidelineSubject: Smile design veneer preparation and bonding protocol

hasPart.name: Tooth Whitening (Bleaching)
hasPart.description: Safe peroxide-based whitening under dental supervision. Improves brightness by 5–7 shades. Options: In-office light activation or home trays.

guideline.guidelineSubject: Hydrogen or carbamide peroxide use in whitening

hasPart.name: Composite Bonding
hasPart.description: Resin restoration to close gaps, fix minor chips, and correct tooth contour. Single-visit esthetic correction.

hasPart.name: Crown & Bridge Prosthodontics
hasPart.description: Full-coverage restorations for damaged or missing teeth. Metal-ceramic, all-ceramic, or zirconia materials used for strength and esthetics.
hasPart.followup: Annual review for occlusion, hygiene, and crown integrity.

hasPart.name: Digital Smile Design (DSD)
hasPart.description: Photography and facial analysis-based smile simulation for preview and treatment planning.
hasPart.guidelineSubject: Digital planning and patient-centered esthetic design

hasPart.name: Tooth Discoloration
hasPart.description: Extrinsic (surface stain) or intrinsic (internal) discoloration due to coffee, tobacco, trauma, or aging.

hasPart.name: Diastema (Tooth Gap)
hasPart.description: Midline or interdental space due to size–arch mismatch or habits.

hasPart.name: Fractured Front Tooth
hasPart.description: Aesthetic and functional emergency following trauma.

hasPart.name: Tooth Contouring & Reshaping
hasPart.description: Minor enamel adjustments to improve alignment or shape; often combined with bonding.

hasPart.name: Pediatric Esthetic Dentistry
hasPart.description: Restoration of primary teeth with tooth-colored materials; prevention of trauma discoloration; stainless steel or zirconia crowns for function and appearance.

possibleTreatment.name: Strip crown or zirconia crown in children
Composite build-up for fractured primary tooth

subjectOf.name: Principles of Smile Esthetics
subjectOf.description: Balance, proportion, harmony, midline, incisal curve, gingival zenith; used in DSD and clinical evaluation.

subjectOf.name: Safety of Tooth Whitening
subjectOf.description: Ensure proper isolation, avoid overuse, assess sensitivity; hydrogen peroxide concentration ≤6% for home kits.

citation.name: Smile Design: From Digital Planning to Clinical Execution

audience.audienceType: Patients seeking smile enhancement or pediatric esthetics
